+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe Member, type: :model do
+  describe "validations" do
+    it "requires an email" do
+      member = build(:member, email: nil)
+      expect(member).not_to be_valid
+      expect(member.errors[:email]).to include("can't be blank")
+    end
+
+    it "does not require pt_school_application_date in the default context" do
+      expect(build(:member)).to be_valid
+    end
+
+    it "requires pt_school_application_date in the :profile context" do
+      member = build(:member, pt_school_application_date: nil)
+      expect(member.valid?(:profile)).to be false
+      expect(member.errors[:pt_school_application_date]).to include("can't be blank")
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "associations" do
+    it "belongs to a role" do
+      expect(Member.reflect_on_association(:role).macro).to eq(:belongs_to)
+    end
+
+    it "destroys dependent rsvps when the member is destroyed" do
+      member = create(:member)
+      create(:rsvp, member: member)
+
+      expect { member.destroy }.to change(Rsvp, :count).by(-1)
+    end
+
+    it "destroys dependent attendances when the member is destroyed" do
+      member = create(:member)
+      create(:attendance, member: member, event: create(:event))
+
+      expect { member.destroy }.to change(Attendance, :count).by(-1)
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "#profile_completed?" do
+    it "is true when profile_completed_at is present" do
+      expect(build(:member, :profile_completed)).to be_profile_completed
+    end
+
+    it "is false when profile_completed_at is nil (the default)" do
+      expect(build(:member)).not_to be_profile_completed
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "#admin?" do
+    it "is true for a member with the admin role" do
+      expect(build(:member, :admin).admin?).to be true
+    end
+
+    it "is false for a member with a non-admin role" do
+      expect(build(:member).admin?).to be false
+    end
+
+    it "is false when the member has no role" do
+      expect(build(:member, role: nil).admin?).to be false
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe ".from_google" do
+    let(:google_params) do
+      {
+        email: "New.Student@tamu.edu",
+        first_name: "New",
+        last_name: "Student",
+        uid: "12345",
+        avatar_url: "https://example.com/avatar.png"
+      }
+    end
+
+    it "returns nil for a non-tamu.edu email" do
+      result = Member.from_google(**google_params.merge(email: "someone@gmail.com"))
+      expect(result).to be_nil
+    end
+
+    it "creates a new member with a default Member role and today's join date" do
+      expect { Member.from_google(**google_params) }.to change(Member, :count).by(1)
+
+      member = Member.find_by(email: "new.student@tamu.edu")
+      expect(member.first_name).to eq("New")
+      expect(member.last_name).to eq("Student")
+      expect(member.role.description).to eq("Member")
+      expect(member.joined_at).to eq(Date.current)
+    end
+
+    it "reuses an existing Member role instead of creating a duplicate" do
+      create(:role)
+
+      expect { Member.from_google(**google_params) }.not_to change(Role, :count)
+    end
+
+    it "finds and updates an existing member by email instead of duplicating them" do
+      existing = create(:member, email: "new.student@tamu.edu", uid: "old-uid")
+
+      expect { Member.from_google(**google_params) }.not_to change(Member, :count)
+
+      existing.reload
+      expect(existing.uid).to eq("12345")
+      expect(existing.avatar_url).to eq("https://example.com/avatar.png")
+    end
+  end
+end

+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe "Members::OmniauthCallbacks", type: :request do
+  before { OmniAuth.config.test_mode = true }
+
+  after do
+    OmniAuth.config.test_mode = false
+    OmniAuth.config.mock_auth[:google_oauth2] = nil
+  end
+
+  def mock_google_auth(email:, uid: "google-uid-123", first_name: "Ada", last_name: "Lovelace")
+    OmniAuth.config.mock_auth[:google_oauth2] = OmniAuth::AuthHash.new(
+      provider: "google_oauth2",
+      uid: uid,
+      info: {
+        email: email,
+        first_name: first_name,
+        last_name: last_name,
+        image: "https://example.com/avatar.png"
+      }
+    )
+  end
+
+  describe "GET /members/auth/google_oauth2/callback" do
+    context "with a tamu.edu email" do
+      it "signs in an existing member and redirects to root" do
+        member = create(:member, :profile_completed, email: "ada#{Member::ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN}")
+        mock_google_auth(email: member.email)
+
+        get member_google_oauth2_omniauth_callback_path
+
+        expect(response).to redirect_to(root_path)
+      end
+
+      it "creates a new member on first sign-in and sends them to finish their profile" do
+        mock_google_auth(email: "brandnew#{Member::ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN}")
+
+        expect {
+          get member_google_oauth2_omniauth_callback_path
+        }.to change(Member, :count).by(1)
+
+        expect(response).to redirect_to(edit_profile_path)
+
+        new_member = Member.find_by(email: "brandnew#{Member::ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN}")
+        expect(new_member.role.description).to eq("Member")
+      end
+    end
+
+    context "with a non-tamu.edu email" do
+      it "does not sign the member in and redirects to sign in with an alert" do
+        mock_google_auth(email: "someone@gmail.com")
+
+        expect {
+          get member_google_oauth2_omniauth_callback_path
+        }.not_to change(Member, :count)
+
+        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_member_session_path)
+        expect(flash[:alert]).to match(/Texas A&M account/)
+      end
+    end
+  end
+end

+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe "Members", type: :request do
+  let(:admin) { create(:member, :admin, :profile_completed) }
+  let(:regular_member) { create(:member, :profile_completed) }
+
+  describe "GET /members" do
+    context "when signed out" do
+      it "redirects to sign in" do
+        get members_path
+        expect(response).to redirect_to(new_member_session_path)
+      end
+    end
+
+    context "when signed in as a non-admin member" do
+      before { sign_in regular_member }
+
+      it "redirects to root with an alert" do
+        get members_path
+        expect(response).to redirect_to(root_path)
+      end
+    end
+
+    context "when the signed-in admin's own profile is incomplete" do
+      before { sign_in create(:member, :admin) }
+
+      it "redirects to the profile edit form first" do
+        get members_path
+        expect(response).to redirect_to(edit_profile_path)
+      end
+    end
+
+    context "when signed in as an admin with a completed profile" do
+      before { sign_in admin }
+
+      it "returns a successful response and lists members" do
+        create(:member, :profile_completed, first_name: "Alex")
+
+        get members_path
+
+        expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
+        expect(response.body).to include("Alex")
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "PATCH /members/:id" do
+    before { sign_in admin }
+
+    it "updates the member's paid_dues status and redirects to the index" do
+      target = create(:member, :profile_completed, paid_dues: false)
+
+      patch member_path(target), params: { member: { paid_dues: true } }
+
+      expect(response).to redirect_to(members_path)
+      expect(target.reload.paid_dues).to be true
+    end
+
+    it "ignores attributes other than paid_dues" do
+      target = create(:member, :profile_completed, points: 5)
+
+      patch member_path(target), params: { member: { paid_dues: true, points: 999 } }
+
+      expect(target.reload.points).to eq(5)
+    end
+  end
+end

+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe "Profiles", type: :request do
+  let(:member) { create(:member) }
+
+  before { sign_in member }
+
+  describe "GET /profile/edit" do
+    it "returns a successful response" do
+      get edit_profile_path
+      expect(response).to have_http_status(:success)
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "PATCH /profile" do
+    let(:valid_params) do
+      {
+        member: {
+          first_name: "Taylor",
+          last_name: "Reed",
+          pt_school_application_date: 1.year.from_now.to_date.to_s,
+          car_pool_status: "1"
+        }
+      }
+    end
+
+    it "saves a valid profile, marks it complete, and redirects to root" do
+      patch profile_path, params: valid_params
+
+      expect(response).to redirect_to(root_path)
+      member.reload
+      expect(member.first_name).to eq("Taylor")
+      expect(member).to be_profile_completed
+    end
+
+    it "re-renders the form when pt_school_application_date is missing" do
+      patch profile_path, params: { member: { first_name: "Taylor", last_name: "Reed", pt_school_application_date: "" } }
+
+      expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_content)
+      expect(member.reload.profile_completed?).to be false
+    end
+
+    it "does not allow a member to assign their own role or points" do
+      admin_role = create(:role, :admin)
+      original_role_id = member.role_id
+
+      patch profile_path, params: valid_params.deep_merge(member: { role_id: admin_role.id, points: 500 })
+
+      member.reload
+      expect(member.role_id).to eq(original_role_id)
+      expect(member.points).not_to eq(500)
+    end
+  end
+end
